wargear.name: Shadow-banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A dull black standard of dark feathers that seems to drink the light around it. Every model in the unit gains +1 Intelligence and Shrouded (6+).

wargear.name: Corvid dirge-shroud
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tattered mourning-cloak worn over the armour of the Isstvan survivors, hiding the bearer in smoke and sorrow. The model gains Shrouded (6+).

wargear.name: Night-sight visor
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A black-lensed visor tuned to the dark between stars. Gives the model Dark Sight.

wargear.name: Raptor-pinion harness
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A light glide-frame of feathered vanes. Gives the model Pinion Glide.

wargear.name: Gloom smoke launchers
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Banks of shadow-smoke tubes along the hull. The vehicle gains Gloom Veil.

wargear.name: Pathfinder's markers
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Hooded beacons left along the approach. Every model in the unit gains Hidden Trail.

wargear.name: Dirge banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A banner of black feathers bearing the names of the dead. Every model in the unit gains Standard of the Dirge.

wargear.name: Talon-sheath gauntlets
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Spring-loaded blades concealed in the wrists. The model gains +1 Attack on a turn its unit charges, and gains Raven's Strike.

rites.name: Wings of the Corvid
rites.flavor: A hundred shapes drop out of the smoke, and by the time you count them they are among you.
benefits: Dark Fury and Destroyer Assault Squads may fill Troops slots.
Every Antigrav Infantry unit gains Deep Strike and Out of the Smoke: on the turn it arrives by Deep Strike it may Charge with no penalty.
limitations: Every Antigrav Infantry unit must start the battle in Reserve, and at least one Dark Fury Squad is required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Terminator squads.

modifiers.text: Wings of the Corvid: Deep Strike, Out of the Smoke.

require.note: Bring at least one Dark Fury Squad.

rites.name: Whispers in the Dark
rites.flavor: The enemy never sees the first hundred. The hundred and first is already behind him.
benefits: Reconnaissance, Scout and Mor Deythan Squads may fill Troops slots.
Reconnaissance and Scout Squads gain Infiltrate (6) and Unseen Hunters: on the first battle turn enemy units may not Shoot at or Charge them from more than 12" away.
limitations: At least one Reconnaissance or Scout Squad is required.
No Armour, Support, Heavy Transport, War Engine or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Whispers in the Dark: Infiltrate (6), Unseen Hunters.

require.note: Bring a Reconnaissance or Scout Squad.

rites.name: Survivors of the Black Dirge
rites.flavor: Isstvan took the Legion's wings. What was left learned to stand.
benefits: Deliverers Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Deliverers gain Last Stand of the Dirge: they automatically pass Morale and Pinning checks.
limitations: Corvus Corax must lead the army, and at least one Deliverers Squad is required.
No Recon or Fast Attack units, and no unit may start the battle in Reserve.

modifiers.text: Survivors of the Black Dirge: Line (1), Last Stand of the Dirge.

require.note: Bring at least one Deliverers Squad.

rites.name: Knives Among the Stars
rites.flavor: One blade, one name, one quiet corridor, and the war ends before it begins.
benefits: Moritat, Moritat Mortalis, Pathfinders and Kaedes Nex gain Precision (5+) and Blade in the Dark: after both sides deploy, each may make a free move of up to 6".
limitations: At least two of Moritat, Moritat Mortalis, Pathfinder or Kaedes Nex are required.
At most one High Command unit, and no Retinue or Heavy Assault units.

modifiers.text: Knives Among the Stars: Precision (5+), Blade in the Dark.

limit.note: At most one High Command unit.

rules.name: Out of the Smoke
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Wings of the Corvid). A unit with this rule that arrives by Deep Strike may declare a Charge on the turn it arrives without the usual penalty.

rules.name: Unseen Hunters
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Whispers in the Dark). On the first battle turn, enemy units may not target a unit with this rule with Shooting Attacks or Charges unless they begin within 12" of it.

rules.name: Last Stand of the Dirge
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Survivors of the Black Dirge). A unit with this rule automatically passes Morale and Pinning checks.

rules.name: Blade in the Dark
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Knives Among the Stars). After both sides have deployed and before the first battle turn, a unit with this rule may make a free move of up to 6". It can't end that move within 9" of an enemy model.

rules.name: Dark Sight
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The unit of a model with this rule ignores the first -1 modifier from Shrouded or cover applied to the Hit Tests of its Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Pinion Glide
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The unit of a model with this rule adds 2" to its Rush distance, and the model ignores difficult terrain.

rules.name: Gloom Veil
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of the enemy Shooting phase, a vehicle with this rule may declare that all Shooting Attacks against it this phase are made as Snap Shots.

rules.name: Hidden Trail
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule may be placed 3" further forward when it makes a Set-up Move, and cannot be targeted by Shooting Attacks from more than 24" on the first battle turn.

rules.name: Standard of the Dirge
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule adds 1 to its Cool Checks. Once per battle it may ignore the Routed, Pinned or Suppressed Status.

rules.name: Raven's Strike
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A model with this rule that charges strikes before its foes settle: it adds 1 to its Initiative in the first Initiative Step of that Combat.

armyRules.name: Lightfoot Raiders
armyRules.condition: while locked in Combat with a unit that has more models
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Raven Guard raiders slip through ground others cannot cross. A unit with this rule adds 2" to Rush and Set-up Move distances. They are poor at standing toe to toe: while locked in Combat with a unit that has more models, they suffer -1 Cool.

armyRules.name: Ghost of the Shadow War
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy Shooting Attacks against a unit with this rule from more than 18" subtract 1 from their Hit Tests. Hunters of the dark see little at distance themselves: the unit subtracts 1 from the Hit Tests of its own Shooting Attacks against targets more than 24" away.

armyRules.name: Dirge-Marked Survivors
armyRules.condition: while below half its starting models
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Isstvan taught the Legion how to die slowly. A unit with this rule has a 6+ Invulnerable Save if it was worse while below half its starting models. Grief drives it: if it lost a model to an enemy unit last turn, it must declare a Charge against that unit if able.
